messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Patients on Tirzepatide 15 mg weekly lost an average of 20.9% or 48.6 lb of body weight.
This occurred after 72 weeks in the Zepbound Study 1 (NCT04184622).
Placebo patients lost an average of 3.1% or 7.2 lb of body weight.
Study 1 was a 72-week trial.
The trial compared Zepbound weight loss with placebo.
The trial included adults with obesity or overweight with at least one weight-related condition.
The trial excluded patients with type 2 diabetes.
Zepbound Weight Loss Results at 72 Weeks by Dose:
Treatment dose | Average % weight loss | Average weight lost | Average starting weight
Zepbound 5 mg | 15.0% | 34.0 lb | 226.9 lb
Zepbound 10 mg | 19.5% | 45.5 lb | 233.2 lb
Zepbound 15 mg | 20.9% | 48.6 lb | 232.8 lb
Placebo | 3.1% | 7.2 lb | 231.0 lb
Triples: [["Tirzepatide", "has dose", "15 mg weekly"], ["Tirzepatide 15 mg weekly", "resulted in average weight loss of", "20.9% or 48.6 lb"], ["Tirzepatide 15 mg weekly", "studied in", "Zepbound Study 1 (NCT04184622)"], ["Zepbound Study 1 (NCT04184622)", "duration", "72 weeks"], ["Placebo", "resulted in average weight loss of", "3.1% or 7.2 lb"], ["Zepbound Study 1 (NCT04184622)", "compared", "Zepbound weight loss with placebo"], ["Zepbound Study 1 (NCT04184622)", "included", "adults with obesity or overweight with at least one weight-related condition"], ["Zepbound Study 1 (NCT04184622)", "excluded", "patients with type 2 diabetes"], ["Zepbound Study 1 (NCT04184622)", "has weight loss results by dose", "Zepbound 5 mg"], ["Zepbound Study 1 (NCT04184622)", "has weight loss results by dose", "Zepbound 10 mg"], ["Zepbound Study 1 (NCT04184622)", "has weight loss results by dose", "Zepbound 15 mg"], ["Zepbound Study 1 (NCT04184622)", "has weight loss results by dose", "Placebo"], ["Zepbound 5 mg", "average weight loss", "15.0%"], ["Zepbound 5 mg", "average weight lost", "34.0 lb"], ["Zepbound 5 mg", "average starting weight", "226.9 lb"], ["Zepbound 10 mg", "average weight loss", "19.5%"], ["Zepbound 10 mg", "average weight lost", "45.5 lb"], ["Zepbound 10 mg", "average starting weight", "233.2 lb"], ["Zepbound 15 mg", "average weight loss", "20.9%"], ["Zepbound 15 mg", "average weight lost", "48.6 lb"], ["Zepbound 15 mg", "average starting weight", "232.8 lb"], ["Placebo", "average weight loss", "3.1%"], ["Placebo", "average weight lost", "7.2 lb"], ["Placebo", "average starting weight", "231.0 lb"]]
Relations: ["average starting weight", "average weight loss", "average weight lost", "compared", "duration", "excluded", "has dose", "has weight loss results by dose", "included", "resulted in average weight loss of", "studied in"]
Answer:

completion:
average starting weight: The subject treatment or group had participants with the average initial body weight specified by the object entity.  
average weight loss: The subject treatment or group resulted in the average percentage of body weight loss specified by the object entity.  
average weight lost: The subject treatment or group resulted in the average amount of body weight lost, in pounds, specified by the object entity.  
compared: The subject study compared the specified object entity with another treatment or condition.  
duration: The subject study lasted for the specified object entity length of time.  
excluded: The subject study excluded participants who had the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.  
has dose: The subject drug is administered at the dose specified by the object entity.  
has weight loss results by dose: The subject study provided weight loss results for the treatment dose specified by the object entity.  
included: The subject study included participants who had the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.  
resulted in average weight loss of: The subject treatment resulted in the average weight loss specified by the object entity.  
studied in: The subject treatment was evaluated in the clinical study specified by the object entity.
